name: Arani

queries.query: Arani Tamil Nadu official cadastral parcel map GIS land records viewer
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Arani Municipality, the Tiruvannamalai District Survey Department land-services page, Tamil Nadu e-Services, and the TamilNilam Geo-Info service. The district page states that citizens can view Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR extracts, A-Register extracts, verify Patta, and verify Poramboke land. No anonymous parcel-feature response was obtained.

queries.result: Tamil first-party discovery identified the Tiruvannamalai district Tamil land-services page, which lists Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register, Patta verification, and Poramboke verification services; the district revenue page also lists Arani as a revenue division/taluk. No public anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was exposed by the search results.

registryEvidence.custodian: Government of Tamil Nadu, Department of Survey and Land Records; Tiruvannamalai District Survey Department / Arani revenue taluk
registryEvidence.scope: Local district and taluk survey/land-records custodian. The official Tiruvannamalai district service page names the Assistant Director, Survey Department and provides land-record service routes; the official Tamil revenue page lists Arani as a revenue division/taluk.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This evidences a local survey/land-records custodian and public service route, not open citywide parcel geometry access. Tamil Nadu and national service descriptions are service context, not substitutes for the local custodian evidence.
